questions.question: Closing the task grill for drill-transactions-api. Nine findings. Eight settled from the repo — three of them were real bugs-in-waiting: (a) **twelve budget batches, not one** — budget ingest writes one per workbook month, so the outline is pinned to the batch whose period equals the block's end, which is what the statement itself reads; (b) **DATE columns come back a day early east of UTC** — the adapter serializes through `toISOString()`, the same bug the statement already hit, so dates are normalized from local parts with a non-UTC test; (c) **four registration files were missing from write scope** — without `app.routes.test.ts` the route isn't proven to exist, and without the two test scripts CI runs none of the new tests. Plus UUID validation before SQL, per-batch status instead of a scalar flag, D-0038 for mapping-master drift across deploys, and the route-scoped audit filter you chose. Any remaining gap before I delegate this to Codex?
